decisions.reason: The same-message INTRODUCE already captures the simple, easy-to-navigate layout characteristics; no additional state change is required.
Listing locations for easy navigation affects the master location-selection hub, not the reusable structure used to onboard and build individual location sites.
The navigation layout does not change per-location control or separate booking, revenue, and sales tracking; the same source's control clause is already represented separately.
The source's location-listing navigation rule does not change the Wix Bookings platform or location-site booking behavior.
The navigation layout does not change the Smash Room brand name or its application across the master and location sites.
